prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: YouTube Music initially expanded to **17 countries** in 2018—5 original markets plus 12 additional ones. None was described as having **paid-only** access; the service also had an ad-supported tier.
